note: S075 (#240). The npm half of optional-dependency readiness; requirements-optional.txt is the pip half. Everything here is OPTIONAL — the harness runs without node entirely. install_root is ~/.claude and NOT skills/_meta, deliberately: publish-config.json has no file-exclusion mechanism, so anything under skills/ is staged for the public repo, and node_modules must never be. Node resolves bare specifiers by walking node_modules upward, so skills/_meta/*.mjs finds a package installed at ~/.claude/.

capabilities.unlocks: Real-browser DOM geometry — the measured UX review lane and visual arbitration
capabilities.without: The UI verification lane cannot execute at all. This is not hypothetical: puppeteer-core was never installed on this host until S073, so the lane had NEVER run, and fixing its resolution repaired 7 pre-existing test failures that had been mistaken for test rot.

not_listed.puppeteer: The full `puppeteer` package downloads its own Chromium (~150 MB). `puppeteer-core` drives a browser already on the machine, which is what we want — the host Chrome is the binding constraint anyway (#50).
not_listed.playwright: Considered and not adopted: Playwright over the same Chrome is binding diversity, not renderer diversity (#50), so it buys less than it costs.
